Name: Nonbinary TheyThem Maddie - Ridgeside Village Add-on
Author: AirynS
Description:
A small self-indulgent mod, this changes Maddie from Ridgeside Village to use they/them pronouns, because who doesn't love having more nonbinary characters in Stardew Valley? Big thanks to Rafseazz for his permission to create this!

Includes compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]! If installed, Maddie (and Kiarra!) will stand over at the nonbinary stall during the Ridgeside Gathering. Thanks to Tiakall for writing Kiarra's new dialogue!

To install, simply unzip the "[CP] Nonbinary TheyThem Maddie" folder and drop it in your Mods folder. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village [/url]and all of its necessary mods, of course.

Maddie's portraits are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18202]Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village[/url] and Trinnie's are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]'s RSV compatibility.
